name: UF-style-dosega
note: dosega — the dosegafx EGA LoRA (its trigger comes from the style) + EGA palette, 128x128. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 1. Twin of FACTORY/style-dosega.  (sample: seed 1465)

form.subject: a (desert raider:1.3) with a (spiked shoulder pad:1.2), scarred face
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (full body:1.2), cropped head, (multiple faces:1.2)

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (desert raider:1.3) with a (spiked shoulder pad:1.2), scarred face' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora dosegafx.safetensors --lora-strength 0.9 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (full body:1.2), cropped head, (multiple faces:1.2)' --style dosega,portrait --out 128x128 --palette EGA --despeckle 1 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --thin-lines 2 --seed 1465
